description: We are an insanely powerful, sexy, ambitious, unstoppable Ukrainian team! We have brains, passion, energy, and the legendary spirit of Patron the Dog. We are proud Ukrainian patriots, born to create, innovate, and conquer the universe. We carry Donbas in our hearts, emerald skies above our heads, and the red viburnum of Ukraine in our souls. We don't follow the rules of greatness — we make them. We don't just participate — WE DOMINATE. GLORY TO UKRAINE! 🇺🇦🚀🔥
